title: Itsme
tagline: Turn Telegram chats into a digital human you can talk to, preserving memory onchain.
description: Our project turns a person’s Telegram chat history into a digital human that can keep speaking in their tone, memories, and emotional style. The idea was inspired by Coco: a person truly disappears only when they are forgotten. We want to fight that with technology by letting people preserve their identity, stories, and way of speaking as an interactive AI presence. Users export their Telegram conversations, transform them into a training dataset, and fine-tune a model with 0G’s AI infrastructure so the result feels like a living memory instead of a static archive. The goal is not just chat backup, but a new form of cyber immortality.
how_its_made: We built the current prototype as a cinematic AI terminal experience using React 19, TypeScript, Vite, Tailwind CSS v4, Motion, and Lucide icons. The frontend simulates the full user journey: connecting a wallet, entering the protocol dashboard, selecting AI entities, and chatting with a digital persona through a dark sci-fi interface. Under the hood, the product is designed around a pipeline where Telegram exports are cleaned, structured into dialogue data, and used for persona-level model fine-tuning with 0G. We also prepared the app for AI integration through a configurable API layer, making it easy to connect inference later. The hacky but fun part was treating memory preservation like a “deployment protocol,” turning a deeply emotional concept into an onchain-native product experience.
auto_summary: A web prototype and Python toolkit that exports Telegram chats and prepares persona fine-tuning workflows for a digital-memory chatbot concept.
